name: halo-card

frames.best_why: Cleanest still: the full card with its pink-and-cyan glow is visible and no cursor covers it.

tagline: Dark card with a pink, purple and cyan glow shifting along its lower edge.
summary: A rounded, frosted dark card with a hairline border and soft multicolour light bleeding from under its bottom edge. It stacks a heading, a short paragraph, an avatar list and two pill buttons, and lights its rim on hover.
appearance: A wide rounded rectangle in near-black with a translucent, slightly lighter surface and a one-pixel border. A blurred band of pink, magenta and cyan light glows behind the lower half, brightest beneath the footer buttons, and the whole panel sits on a black page.
behaviour: The coloured glows drift slowly side to side all the time. Hovering the card or focusing something inside brightens the border and sweeps a moving streak of light around the rim; the primary button carries its own matching glow.
demo_content: "Invite your team" card listing Priya Raman, Marcus Webb and Lena Fischer with roles and Cancel / Send invites buttons.
search_phrases: dark card with colorful glow around the edge
frosted glass card with gradient border
team member list with avatar rows
card with pink and blue light underneath
glowing border container for a form
use_when: A dark app needs a standout container for a short list or a settings block.
avoid_when: The glow is heavy and decorative, so light themes and dense dashboard grids will look busy.
customise: Frosted surface, hover rim and padding are props; the header, title, description, list, footer and buttons are slots you compose from exported subcomponents.
weight_why: Three blurred gradient blobs animate forever through motion, plus a frame-loop rim trail.

a11y.note: Focus inside the card triggers the same rim effect as hover, buttons show focus rings, and reduced-motion stops the looping glows.

issues: The frames barely move, so the signature hover rim and moving light are never shown.
polish_why: Crisp spacing and a convincing glassy glow; the recording does not demonstrate its animated rim.
